sql.W2: SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Company, c.Country FROM Customer c WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'
sql.W3:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Company

FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'

question: List all track names in the Rock genre.

sql.W1: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE GenreId = (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Rock')
sql.W2: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE GenreId IN (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Rock')
sql.W3: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE GenreId IN (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Rock')
sql.W4: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE GenreId IN (SELECT GenreId FROM Genre WHERE Name = 'Rock')
sql.E:
SELECT T.Name 
FROM Track AS T 
JOIN Genre AS G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId 
WHERE G.Name = 'Rock'

question: Which albums were made by AC/DC?

sql.W1: SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE Name = 'AC/DC')
sql.W2:
SELECT T3.Title FROM Album AS T1 
JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId 
JOIN Track AS T3 ON T1.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId 
WHERE T2.Name = 'AC/DC'
sql.W3:
SELECT T3.Title FROM Album AS T1 
JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId 
JOIN Track AS T3 ON T1.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId 
WHERE T2.Name = 'AC/DC'
sql.W4: SELECT T1.Title FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T2.Name = 'AC/DC'
sql.E: SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE Name = 'AC/DC')

question: Which employees support customers from Canada?

sql.W2: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'
sql.W3: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'
sql.W4: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'
sql.E:

JOIN Customer AS C ON E.EmployeeId = C.SupportRepId

question: List every track with its album title and artist name.

sql.W1:
SELECT Track.Name AS TrackName, Album.Title AS AlbumTitle, Artist.Name AS ArtistName FROM Track 
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId 
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
sql.W2:
SELECT T1.Name AS TrackName, T3.Title AS AlbumTitle, T4.ArtistName 
FROM Track AS T1 
JOIN Album AS T3 ON T1.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId 
JOIN Artist AS T4 ON T3.ArtistId = T4.ArtistId
sql.W3:
SELECT T1.Name AS TrackName, T3.Title AS AlbumTitle, T4.ArtistName 
FROM Track AS T1 
JOIN Album AS T3 ON T1.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId 
JOIN Artist AS T4 ON T3.ArtistId = T4.ArtistId
sql.W4: SELECT T1.Name AS TrackTitle, T3.Title AS ArtistName, T2.Title AS AlbumTitle FROM Track AS T1 JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId JOIN Artist AS T3 ON T1.ArtistId = T3.ArtistId
sql.E:
SELECT Track.Name AS TrackName, Album.Title AS AlbumTitle, Artist.Name AS ArtistName FROM Track 
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId 
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId

question: Which customers bought tracks from the Rock genre?

sql.W1:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerId FROM Customer AS T1 
JOIN OrderDetail AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerID 
JOIN [Order] AS T3 ON T2.OrderID = T3.OrderID 
JOIN Track AS T4 ON T3.OrderID = T4.AlbumId 
JOIN Album AS T5 ON T4.AlbumId = T5.AlbumId 
JOIN MediaType AS T6 ON T5.MediaTypeId = T6.MediaTypeId
sql.W2:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerName
FROM Customer AS T1
JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN InvoiceLine AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceID = T3.InvoiceID
JOIN Track AS T4 ON T3.TrackID = T4.TrackID
JOIN Genre AS T5 ON T4.GenreID = T5.GenreID
WHERE T5.Name = 'Rock'
sql.W3: SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerID FROM Customer AS T1 INNER JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN InvoiceLine AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceID = T3.InvoiceID INNER JOIN Track AS T4 ON T3.TrackID = T4.TrackID INNER JOIN Genre AS T5 ON T4.GenreID = T5.GenreID WHERE T5.Name = 'Rock'
sql.W4:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
sql.E:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.CustomerId FROM Customer AS T1 
JOIN OrderDetail AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerID 
JOIN [Order] AS T3 ON T2.OrderID = T3.OrderID 
JOIN Track AS T4 ON T3.OrderID = T4.AlbumId 
JOIN Album AS T5 ON T4.AlbumId = T5.AlbumId 
JOIN MediaType AS T6 ON T5.MediaTypeId = T6.MediaTypeId

question: How many tracks does each genre have?

sql.W1:
SELECT GenreId, COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) AS NumberOfTracks
FROM Track
GROUP BY GenreId
sql.W2:
SELECT Genre.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(DISTINCT Track.TrackId) AS NumberOfTracks
FROM Track
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY Genre.Name
sql.W3:
SELECT Genre.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(DISTINCT Track.TrackId) AS NumberOfTracks
FROM Track
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY Genre.Name
sql.W4:
SELECT Genre.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfTracks
FROM Track
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY Genre.Name
sql.E:
SELECT GenreId, COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) AS NumberOfTracks
FROM Track
GROUP BY GenreId
